title: 04 — Build Zed synchronization companion
description: Register a lightweight companion LSP for Rust alongside Zed rust-analyzer. No proxy, third analyzer, VS Code implementation, or companion switching. Validate against real Zed early.

todos.title: Create Zed extension and companion executable mode
Forward open/change/save/close and maintain full editor snapshots
Handle initial connection, reconnect, and disk fallback on disconnect
Implement disk-authoritative precedence without replaying stale editor deltas
Verify unsaved changes, dirty-buffer agent edits, and Unicode positions in Zed

notes.text: Zed extension builds for wasm32-wasip1. Actual companion subprocess passes open/change/exit and disk fallback tests. Native Zed automation cannot reliably operate keyboard/menu actions; user offered manual testing and was given the extension installation path. Next: open examples/demo in Zed and verify unsaved state reaches core.

Final automated companion integration passes, including clean exit and reconnect without replaying a superseded editor snapshot. WebAssembly release build and extension clippy pass. Release core is running in SAAHT session editor-lsp-bridge at http://127.0.0.1:47831 with examples/demo attached and a fresh successful Cargo check. Next: user installs zed-extension and opens examples/demo as a Zed workspace for the remaining live test.
